visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde-haired man in a black sports jersey with the number 7 stands on an indoor volleyball court with green flooring. The gym has a high ceiling with visible metal structures and large orange ventilation ducts. (2) A dark-haired man wearing a similar jersey with the number 11 runs across the court. The camera uses fast cuts to show both men jumping and preparing to hit a volleyball. (3) The scene shifts to the dark-haired man lying on the court floor while the blonde-haired man leans over him, shouting and gesturing wildly. The blonde man slaps the dark-haired man on the face. (4) Both men are sitting on a brown leather sofa in a well-lit living room with white curtains. They hold smartphones and look at the screen, reacting with expressions of excitement and satisfaction. (5) The blonde-haired man speaks energetically to the camera, gesturing with his hands. He holds up one, two, and then three fingers. Numerous graphical overlays and text panels appear on the left side of the screen detailing various prizes and service plans. (6) The video ends with a shot of the two men relaxing on the couch, followed by a final scene of the dark-haired man still lying alone on the floor of the empty gym.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Narrative Setup -> Feature Presentation -> Prize Listing -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy advertisement for Chunghwa Telecom's (CHT) 'Super Life Festival.' It uses a comedic volleyball sketch as a hook to transition into a detailed list of promotional offers and luxury prizes available through their online store, aiming to drive traffic and subscriptions.
